description: Makes a new workbook from exactly one of: `document`, markdown you have written, or `sheets`, tabs each {name, markdown}, either of which becomes version 1 at once and runs nothing; or `instruction`, one sentence the way a person would say it ('find 30 US importers of loose leaf tea and the buyer at each'), which starts a run that researches and writes it, takes minutes and uses the account's balance. Nothing that already exists is changed.

document.description: The first version as markdown, written by you.

folder.description: A folder to put it in, e.g. 'Outreach'. Made if missing. Omit for the root.

instruction.description: What the workbook should be, in one sentence. A run writes it, using the account's balance.

name.description: Its name. A name another workbook has is told apart by this one's id.

sheets.description: The first version as tabs, in order.

title.description: What it is shown by, e.g. 'Comps', where the name has to say more. Need not be unique: the name stays its address.

name: create_workbook
title: Start a new workbook
